name: Rattan Marksmen
headerMeta: Silver era · Ranged infantry · 175 leadership · T3 · Mastery
pitch: A high-per-shot poison crossbow line built entirely around Double Shot's double-bolt window, stacking poison and accuracy doctrines to punish anything that stands still. Its actual how-to-use is deferred to an external build video, so the in-thread guidance is doctrines and a veterancy pick only — no positioning, counters, or matchup notes exist on record.

doctrines.name: Epic Crossbow Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: Unlocks Double Shot, fires 2 bolts per shot for 8s, can't combine with Focus Fire, 60s CD. Mandatory per Amya.
doctrines.note: unlocks Double Shot — 2 bolts per shot for 8s, can't combine with Focus Fire, 60s CD

doctrines.name: Poisons Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: +140 all armour penetration, +60 poison DMG per stack, stacks up to 2x.
doctrines.note: +140 all AP, +60 poison DMG, stacks up to 2x

doctrines.name: New Ammo Doctrine IV
doctrines.effect: +35% ammo, +120 piercing AP. Mandatory per Amya.

doctrines.name: Epic Crossbow Doctrine III
doctrines.effect: +23% rate of fire. Mandatory per Amya.

doctrines.name: Gunsight Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: +40% shooting accuracy, +80 piercing DMG. OP notes "likely same doctrine as 'Accuracy Doctrine' on Demesne Arbalists." Mandatory per Amya.
doctrines.note: +40% shooting accuracy, +80 piercing DMG — likely the same doctrine as Demesne Arbalists' Accuracy Doctrine

doctrines.name: Double Fire Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: Alt for Epic Crossbow V -- older Double Fire variant, fires 2 bolts for 8s, 45s CD. Filler.
doctrines.note: older 2-bolt alt to Epic Crossbow V — 45s CD / +12% ROF baseline vs Double Shot's longer CD, shorter duration
